evidence_basis.fact: Primary Handheld SoM freeze is RM121-D8E32 (8GB LPDDR4X + 32GB eMMC). Approved NX5 alternates are RM121-D8E16 / RM121-D8E8 / RM121-D8E0 only (smaller or zero eMMC).
Public Radxa NX5 brief Rev 1.1 verifies RM121-D8E32 memory/storage as 8GB + 32GB eMMC; do not invent undocumented SKUs.
Frozen storage architecture is on-module eMMC plus SoM↔µSD via SDMMC pins; WWAN optional on PCIe; USB3 SS pins mux with PCIe/SATA — no invented remux.
Carrier BOM/netlist models microSD (STORAGE_SDMMC) and records on_module_emmc as 32GB on RM121-D8E32 — not carrier BGA.
Field-kit Phase XV operational decision: OPERATIONALY_UNSAFE (usable_free=-1.74GB).

options_evaluated.title: Module SKU with more eMMC (≥64GB)
options_evaluated.detail: EXACT_MPN_MATRIX lists only RM121-D8E32 (32GB) as primary and smaller eMMC variants as approved alternates. No RM121-D8E64 / UFS / larger NX5 eMMC order code is frozen or verified in-repo. Do not invent unavailable Radxa variants.

options_evaluated.title: Expand carrier storage architecture (NVMe/SATA via PCIe remux)
options_evaluated.detail: Radxa Func columns allow USB3/PCIe/SATA mux on shared SS pins; optional WWAN already claims PCIe2.0. Selecting carrier NVMe would require an explicit remux ADR, Type-C SS / WWAN trade study, mechanical bay, and BOM — not present in current Handheld ICD storage row.
options_evaluated.note: Aligns with older PRD/NVMe intent but is not the current PUBLIC_PINOUT storage freeze.

options_evaluated.title: System-only eMMC + enforced external/user-media policy
options_evaluated.detail: Keep RM121-D8E32 eMMC for OS slots/recovery/update/AI nano core. Move games_local_cache and project_indexes (and optionally large Flatpak caches) to microSD/user media already present in ICD/netlist. Enforce onboard free ≥2.0GB and ≥10% usable.

options_evaluated.title: Further reduce handheld OS/AI/games profile footprint
options_evaluated.detail: Complementary to OPT-C. Device-os / field-kit may shrink AI nano or games cache until usable_free≥2GB and ≥10% even without media. Not a hardware MPN change.

selected_recommendation.rationale: Current architecture already exposes microSD and freezes 32GB on-module eMMC. Realistic EVT0 headroom is policy + profile, not an invented larger Radxa eMMC SKU. Carrier NVMe remains a deferred redesign, not a purchase action under PHYSICAL_EXECUTION_FREEZE. WP-002 implements Outcome A capacity model, policy, growth, and E2E simulation.
